defects.problem: 'Map each to the lane that consumes it' names no method. The one mapping that decides PR 4557 (nix/cmake-tron-test-build.nix:79-101 has no flag, therefore the GCP Nix lane builds OFF) needs the chain gcp-nix.yml:461-463 (tron-build runs `nix build "$recipe^testRuntime,benchmarkRuntime"`) -> flake.nix:1229 (`import ./nix/cmake-tron-test-build.nix`) -> the cmake_args array, plus the rule that an absent option takes its CMakeLists.txt default. For each hit name its consumer: a workflow `run:` line is consumed by that workflow's job; a nix file is consumed by the workflow job whose `nix build` recipe imports it (gcp-nix.yml:461-463 -> flake.nix:1229 -> nix/cmake-tron-test-build.nix:79-101); a CMakePresets.json entry is consumed by whatever runs that preset (the `deb` preset, :57-69, by `make deb` in publish-deb.yml's build job), not by a PR check. defects.quote: Finding shape: "The unit-test and token-identity results are from c12df586b6 / faf8ee42ca, before the merge of main. Please re-run them or mark them as pre-merge."

For perf A/B and objdump a re-run is a day of machine time that procedures.md does not demand (label only). Perf A/B and objdump: add the id and a label; no re-run is demanded. Assertion-count arithmetic between two old ids: defer to check 9 (delete). Finding shape: 'PR description, <section>: the <kind> rows cite <id>, <event: before the merge of main <main id>>; <CHANGED> changed since then. Please <re-run at <HEAD> | delete them, the rows at <HEAD> below replace them | mark them pre-merge and say which files did not change>.'
